clauses.title: The commit takes its message on standard input
The record states what a normal commit is
requires: A normal commit follows Conventional Commits, carries the issue number, and states test provenance in its body when covered behaviour changes.

clauses.title: The record states the bullet-list shape of a commit body and where it is checked
requires: Its body is a bullet list (#166): line 1 is the subject, line 2 is blank, and every line from line 3 on is a bullet, one claim per bullet, with the RED and GREEN measurements as their own bullets, each naming its exact command; trailers stay as trailers after a blank line.
The driver's correction commits take that shape, and this repository's own non-merge commits are checked for it from 2026-09-27, the day after the last non-conforming body.

clauses.title: This repository's commit bodies are checked from the day after the last non-conforming body
